paragraphs: The Defender P400 uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine from Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family, fitted to the L663-generation Defender from 2019 onwards. It's a mild-hybrid (MHEV) unit, meaning it pairs the combustion engine with a 48V electrical system that supports stop-start, coasting and a small power boost. The DC-DC converter that manages the 12V/48V interface is a known failure point, which is why we replace it as standard on every P400 rebuild. The P400 sits above the P300 in the Defender petrol range and shares its engine family with the P400e plug-in hybrid (discontinued after 2020). Land Rover Defender P400 Engine Codes AJ300P (L663) A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol MHEV fitted to the Defender P400 from 2019 to present (L663 generation). Known for DC-DC converter failure — see the callout above. We replace the DC-DC converter, timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every rebuild. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Defender P400 from 2023 to present. The AJ300P features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ300P V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ300P rebuild.
